About LucidRAG

Multi-document intelligence with GraphRAG entity extraction and enterprise features

Our Mission

LucidRAG is an open-source agentic RAG platform that makes multi-document intelligence accessible to everyone. By combining traditional document processing with advanced image analysis, GraphRAG knowledge graphs, and enterprise multi-tenancy, we enable organizations to unlock insights from all their data without being locked into proprietary cloud services.

Technology Stack

Tech Stack Logos Grid
.NET, ASP.NET Core, TailwindCSS, DaisyUI, Alpine.js, HTMX, PostgreSQL, Qdrant

Backend

.NET 10.0, ASP.NET Core, EF Core

Frontend

TailwindCSS, DaisyUI, Alpine.js, HTMX

Databases

PostgreSQL, SQLite, Qdrant, DuckDB

ML Models

ONNX (Florence-2, CLIP), Ollama, Vision LLMs

Image Processing

OpenCV, Tesseract, ImageSharp

OCR

Tesseract, Florence-2, ML-based fusion

Roadmap

Current

5 processing pipelines, 22-wave image analysis, GraphRAG, multi-tenant support (in development)

Q1 2026

Chart extraction, Kubernetes deployment guides, API documentation, performance optimizations

Q2 2026

Video pipeline enhancements, real-time streaming, advanced analytics dashboard, SSO/SAML integration

Future

Mobile apps, advanced AI capabilities, community marketplace, plugin system
